Marcus / Laura — first-pass redlines attached (redlines_marcus_irene.pdf). Major flags:

1) Term swap to 18 months: commercial OK, but legal requests we keep the same termination notice language (60 days) and add auto-renew opt-out window at 12 months to align with our rollout controls.

2) Exhibit C (capacity addendum): we prefer the burst as a one-time credit applied as a token allowance (not an open-ended seat uplift). Suggested wording: "one-time token credit equivalent to 30% of Customer's average monthly consumption during the prior quarter, applied between 2027-01-01 and 2027-03-31."

3) SLA / Credits: customer removed the SLA credits clause in their tracked version — we need SLA remediation language preserved. If Velox insists on modifying SLA credits, require a cap and a mutual remediation plan (we propose cap @ 50% of monthly recurring revenue for the affected month).

4) Data retention / audit logs: small carve needed if they are switching to 18 months for retention triggers. Please confirm whether Velox uses our private deployment (they do not, per notes) — if not, keep standard retention.

5) Liability / Indemnity: Velox redlined to increase carrier limits; acceptable but request certificate prior to signature.

I've annotated all proposed edits inline in the PDF and included suggested alternate language for the Exhibit C paragraph. Please review and decide which items are negotiable vs must-have for legal.

Attachments: redlines_marcus_irene.pdf

Irene Choi
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork & capacity addendum (VLX-2026-REN-47)

Thanks Irene — appreciate the detailed pass. Quick replies inline below (and attached our counter-markup):

- Term swap / auto-renew opt-out: we can accept a 12-month opt-out window instead of 12 months at your suggestion, but we need the effective date of the 18-month term to be 2027-01-01 without mid-term billing adjustments. If there is pro-ration, we need the order form to show the first invoice as a pro-rated amount and subsequent monthly charges beginning 2027-02-01.

- Burst credit: we agree to token-based credit; request the definition be tied to "Average Monthly Consumption (AMC)" for Q4 2026. We suggest AMC = average of Oct/Nov/Dec 2026 consumption to give us runway.

- SLA credits: we can accept a cap but would like a higher threshold — propose cap at 75% MRR for a single impacted month, with a three-month remediation window.

- Liability / certificates: we will provide updated carrier info (attached insurance_certificate_velox.pdf) and accept verification before signature.

Attached: Velox_Renewal_OrderForm_v2_counter.docx (tracked), insurance_certificate_velox.pdf

Can we get a final redline back by EOD Wednesday so we can route internally to finance and legal?

--
Anthony Chu

2) Laura / RevOps: can you update the order form to show a pro-rated first invoice with monthly billing start 2027-02-01 and add the AMC definition tied to Oct/Nov/Dec 2026? Attach updated XLS and send to Anthony/Sofia for final review.

3) Sofia / Velox: once we have Irene's final redline + new order form, we'll publish a DocuSign packet. Marcus to send the DocuSign link and target signature by 2026-11-26 to leave time for PO and finance.
